description: Test suite for ChannelMemberHistoryStore, including tests for logging join/leave events, retrieving channels with activity, handling orphaned rows, and retention policy deletions in the Mattermost server.

methods.name: testLogJoinEvent
methods.description: Tests logging a join event for a channel member.

methods.name: testLogLeaveEvent
methods.description: Tests logging a leave event for a channel member.

methods.name: testGetChannelsWithActivityDuring
methods.description: Tests retrieval of channels with activity during specific time periods.

methods.name: testGetUsersInChannelAtChannelMemberHistory
methods.description: Tests retrieving users in a channel during specific periods based on channel member history.

methods.name: testGetUsersInChannelAtChannelMembers
methods.description: Tests fallback to channel membership data when message export data is unavailable.

methods.name: testPermanentDeleteBatch
methods.description: Tests batch deletion of channel member history records within a time window.

methods.name: testPermanentDeleteBatchForRetentionPolicies
methods.description: Tests deletion of records based on retention policies.

methods.name: testGetChannelsLeftSince
methods.description: Tests retrieval of channels a user has left since a specific time.

methods.name: testDeleteOrphanedRows
methods.description: Tests deletion of orphaned channel member history rows that reference non-existent channels.
